anchors.retainage.percent_bps: retention equal to ten percent (10%) of the amount otherwise due to Subcontractor
anchors.retainage.release_condition: Retention shall be released to Subcontractor with final payment, following Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of final retention from Owner
anchors.retainage.release_days: in no event later than ten (10) days after Contractor receives from Owner the retention attributable to the Subcontract Work
anchors.waivers.conditional_before_progress: a conditional waiver and release on progress payment, in the form prescribed by California Civil Code Section 8132, executed by Subcontractor and covering the amount requested
anchors.waivers.unconditional_after_payment: unconditional waivers and releases on progress payment, in the form prescribed by California Civil Code Section 8134
anchors.waivers.lower_tier_required: executed by Subcontractor and by each of its sub-subcontractors and suppliers of any tier, covering all amounts paid under the immediately preceding application
anchors.waivers.statutory_form_required: in the statutory forms set out in California Civil Code Sections 8132, 8134, 8136 and 8138, as applicable
anchors.offsets.backcharge_setoff: does not cure the failure within five (5) business days after written notice from Contractor, Contractor may perform the obligation itself or through others and deduct the cost of doing so
anchors.offsets.withhold_defective: Contractor may withhold from any payment otherwise due to Subcontractor an amount reasonably sufficient to protect Contractor and Owner on account of: (a) defective or nonconforming work not remedied
anchors.stored_materials: No payment shall be made on account of materials or equipment delivered to the site, or stored on or off the site, that have not yet been incorporated into the Subcontract Work

anomalies.description: Section 5.2 makes owner payment a condition precedent to any obligation to pay and shifts the risk of owner insolvency to the subcontractor (pay-if-paid).
anomalies.anchor: Subcontractor expressly assumes the risk of Owner's nonpayment, insolvency, or delay in payment
